This includes: #The Default skin. #One skin that can be obtained by opening the [[Krampus' Revenge Event#Gifts|Gift of Agony]]. {{Tabber |Default |{{SkinGallery |Title1 = Default |Icon1 = [[File:DefaultCryomancerIconIGAug26.png|200px]] |[[File:OICryomancer0.png|200px]] |Tan skin, light blue, dark blue and white jacket, sleeves and hood with fur trims, light blue pants with fur trims, dark blue shoes, brown belt and leg straps with pockets. Wields a frost thrower to attack enemies. |[[File:OICryomancer1.png|200px]] |Goggles with blue translucent visor, black gloves with blue knuckles and grey armor with neon blue highlights. Dark blue balaclava mask underneath the hair. |[[File:OICryomancer2.png|200px]] |Larger frost tank. |[[File:OICryomancer3.png|200px]] |Dark grey shoulder-pads, grey outer boots and knee-pads. Wields a frost thrower to attack enemies. |[[File:Krampus_Slayer_Cryomancer_1.png|200px]] |Red goggles with green translucent visor and red gloves with fur trims and grey spiked knuckles |[[File:Krampus_Slayer_Cryomancer_2.png|200px]] |Boot pads replaced with hooves and larger frost tank. |[[File:Krampus_Slayer_Cryomancer_3.png|200px]] |Red arm paddings with red, black shoulder-pads and black gas mask with translucent green visor.
